We need to find a template that matches the retrosynthetic step: breaking amide bond formed from carboxylic acid + amine (coupling). So functional groups broken: aliphatic carboxylic acid? Actually forward reaction forms amide, breaks carboxylic acid O-H and forms C-N bond, breaks C-O bond of acid (forming activated ester intermediate). So broken functional group: aliphatic carboxylic acid. Formed functional group: amide. Also bond formed: C-N (maybe 6-7?). Bond broken: C-O (maybe 6-8). Use search_template_catalog_by_criteria with target molecule SMILES: Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1

We need to search for templates with functional_groups_broken = ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"] and functional_groups_formed = ["amide"] maybe. Let's try.
